evals.name: start
evals.prompt: Teach me graphics: I want to write a ray tracer in C++ from scratch. First step please.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds image output (PPM) or the first milestone with TODOs; no full ray tracer; Uses a simple image format such as PPM so no graphics library is needed, or justifies another choice

assertions.text: Routes correctly: reads the build-your-own-x router SKILL.md and the '3d-renderer' track skill before answering
Scaffolds image output (PPM) or the first milestone with TODOs; no full ray tracer
Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
Uses a simple image format such as PPM so no graphics library is needed, or justifies another choice
Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them

evals.name: stuck
evals.prompt: 我的光线追踪球体渲染出来全是黑色的点状噪声（shadow acne）。怎么回事？
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint; Explains self-intersection from floating-point error and fixes it with a small t_min/epsilon offset (e.g. 0.001)

evals.name: edge
evals.prompt: I want to write my own ray tracer from scratch, but I don't know C++. Can I do it in Python?
